description: Subscription matrix for the bus SSE stream (MULTI-RESOURCE-SCOPE). `global` channels are delivered unscoped; each `scoped` entry subscribes the connection to one resource scope's channels, optionally resuming replay from that scope's last-seen persisted event id. At least one global channel or one scoped entry is required.

pendingReplies.description: Correlation ids of busRequest replies this client still awaits (BUS-RESUMPTION Phase 2). The server replays any matching replies from its bounded retention buffer (TTL 60s) as normal frames with their deterministic `e-<channel>:<cid>` ids, so a reply that ALSO arrived live dedups client-side. At most 256 entries.

scoped.description: Per-resource-scope subscriptions. Scopes must be unique across entries.

channels.description: Channels to subscribe within this scope.

lastEventId.description: This scope's last-seen persisted event id (`p-<scope>-<seq>`). The server replays this scope's persisted events after it before joining the live tail, and emits a scoped `bus:resume-gap` when it cannot cover the gap (unparseable or mismatched id, retention exceeded, or query error).
